exclusion_detail: Lead 19 (Scheme 2): HATU coupling of Fmoc-Trp(Boc) 9b with pyrrolidine building block 15, Dess-Martin oxidation, formic acid cyclisation, Fmoc removal, amide coupling with 2-(4,4-difluorocyclohexyl)acetic acid, LiOH ester hydrolysis = 6 reactions; building block 15 is only referenced (ref 37).

lead.why: Abstract: 'favorable ADME and pharmacological profiles for the best compound 19'.

notes: Compound 9 (Scheme 1) needs coupling, Pictet-Spengler, Boc protection, deprotection, Z removal, amide coupling (over 4). Other compounds' procedures are only in the SI (not provided).
